title: AI-ETHICS BY DESIGN. EVALUATING PUBLIC PERCEPTION ON THE IMPORTANCE OF ETHICAL DESIGN PRINCIPLES OF AI.
reasoning: The paper's central research question is to evaluate how the public perceives and prioritizes different ethical principles in the design of AI systems. It uses a conjoint survey to investigate public preferences for principles such as explainability, fairness, security, accountability, accuracy, privacy, and machine autonomy. The entire study is structured around measuring and analyzing these ethical trade-offs, making the evaluation of ethics the core subject of the work, not a peripheral section.
